name: cl.comercioia.shopping.consumer_terms
title: Chilean Consumer Terms
description: OPEN PROPOSAL, ready to implement and open for comment. Not yet stable: fields may change before the first stable release. Carries the information Chilean consumer law asks a distance seller to give before and after an online sale (Ley 19.496, DS 6/2021), plus the retracto and legal warranty policy types for core policies[]. Required notices MUST also be sent as core messages[] warnings with presentation 'disclosure', so platforms that do not know this extension still show them. This schema is not legal advice. Spec: https://comercioia.cl/spec/#consumer-terms

rut.description: Chilean taxpayer ID (RUT) without dots, with a hyphen and the modulo 11 check digit.

seller.description: Identity of the seller shown to the buyer before payment (DS 6/2021).

contacto.description: Email address or https URL where the buyer can reach the seller.

platform_role.description: Plain-language statement of the role of any intermediary platform in the sale.

ai_disclosure.description: Declares that the buyer is interacting through an AI agent (SERNAC Res. Ex. 33/2022). Sent by the platform in requests; echoed by the business.

human_contact.description: How the buyer can reach a person.

installments.description: Present only when the business offers cuotas. The cash price MUST be at least as visible as the installment price (Ley 19.496 arts. 17 G, 37).

total_cost.description: Total cost of credit, integer CLP.

delivery.description: Shipping cost and delivery time shown before payment.

estimated_delivery.description: ISO 8601 date, or a plain-language estimate.

confirmation.description: Written confirmation with a full, clear and legible copy of the contract, sent to the consumer once the contract is concluded, with a link that lets the buyer keep that version (Ley 19.496 art. 12 A). The law sets no general number of hours; the standard requires sending it when the sale closes. Its absence can extend the retracto window from ten to ninety days.

price_includes_tax.description: MUST be true for consumer sales: the total includes taxes.

retracto_policy.title: Policy type cl.comercioia.policy.retracto
retracto_policy.description: Right of withdrawal for distance sales (Ley 19.496 art. 3 bis b, as amended by Ley 21.398). Used inside core policies[].

window_days.description: Calendar days from receipt of the goods (for services, within ten days of contracting and before the service is provided).

window_days_without_confirmation.description: Up to 90 days when the written confirmation was not sent.

exclusion_reason.description: Required when excluded is true. For goods, exclusion is allowed only in the legal categories and conditions (DS 52/2022); it must be disclosed in Spanish before contracting and paying, next to the price, using the words 'derecho a retracto'. It does not remove the legal warranty.

garantia_legal_policy.title: Policy type cl.comercioia.policy.garantia_legal
garantia_legal_policy.description: Legal warranty (Ley 19.496 arts. 20-21; SERNAC Res. Ex. 779/2023). Used inside core policies[].

months.description: Months from receipt: legal warranty for failures or non-conformities covered by law.

remedies.description: Free repair, replacement or refund, as applicable.

remote_claim_channel.description: Remote claim channel or free pickup offered by a distance seller.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Chilean consumer terms
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with seller identity, AI disclosure, delivery and installment information.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Chilean consumer terms
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended with seller identity and the written confirmation.
